# This is a translation of DEVIN_HOOK_EVENTS in Herdr's src/integration/mod.rs at
# HERDR_INTEGRATION_VERSION=2, and it is a fixture rather than a table read out
# of the Go code so a reviewer can diff it against upstream directly on the next
# sync. Every upstream row's action is `session`, which Sidecar spells as the
# report-session verb; upstream has no other action for Devin, because its
# lifecycle rows were removed at version 2 (DEVIN_REMOVED_LIFECYCLE_HOOK_EVENTS
# is the list of what went away, and Sidecar does not reinstate any of it).
# `matcher` is `-` for every row because install_devin calls ensure_command_hook
# with matcher None, unlike the qodercli and qwen installers beside it. A matcher
# key is therefore absent from the written group, not present and empty.
